title: Remove from schedule takes one asset off; history stays
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  2. An asset enrolled on a schedule (e.g. Highway Tractor PM) with an open work order and certificates; you hold the enrol permission. Seed: enrol the asset (asset Maintenance tab -> Enroll in Schedule), raise a work order on it.
custom_steps:
1. On the asset's Maintenance tab, open the schedule's menu and choose "Remove from schedule".
  2. Read the confirmation and its action colour, then confirm.
  3. Check the asset tab, the worklist, the asset's history, its certificates and the open work order afterwards.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • "Remove from schedule" takes that one asset off that schedule; it asks first (e.g. "Remove 402 from Highway Tractor PM?"), the action is red, and it needs the same permission as enrolling.
  • After removal, that schedule's rows leave the asset tab and the worklist; the maintenance history is kept, the certificates stay, and an open work order is not changed.
  • Enrolling the asset again later counts from its last completion; changing an asset's schedule is "Remove from schedule" then "Enrol".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
